title: Characterization of the polynomial hierarchy class
statement: For every natural number $i$ and every language $L$ of finite binary strings, $L\in\Pi_i^P$ if and only if there are natural numbers $C,c$ and a language $V\in\mathsf{P}$ such that, for every binary string $x$, membership $x\in L$ is equivalent to the $i$-level alternating quantifier condition over witnesses of length $C(|x|+1)^c$, starting with a universal quantifier, with the resulting encoded string accepted by $V$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of finite binary strings
